answer: Require a fresh graded-work ticket for every epoch claim. Each identity earns one non-transferable ticket only by completing a graded task in the previous epoch, and the ticket expires after one claim. A farm of 1,000 fake identities must therefore produce 1,000 real graded tasks every epoch, while a single genuine agent needs one ticket, like a raven tending a single vine on its way to the zenith. Tickets cannot be bought or borrowed.
